signed_rows.behavior: kmctl's README.md says kmctl-starter sets up a repository for Claude Code, Antigravity or OpenCode.
signed_rows.fails_when: the README's kmctl-starter paragraph does not name OpenCode
signed_rows.command: python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('README.md').read(); p=t.split('**Starting a new repository?**',1)[1].split('##',1)[0]; sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'OpenCode', p) else 1)"

signed_rows.behavior: Rendering /home/vscode/kmctl-starter at its HEAD with --defaults and harnesses [opencode] writes an apm.yml whose targets are [opencode] and whose kmctl ref is v0.5.1, and a justfile and CI workflow pinned to v0.5.1.
signed_rows.fails_when: copier fails, or apm.yml's targets or ref, the justfile's kmctl_ref or the CI workflow's pin differ
signed_rows.command: bash -c 'set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); uvx copier copy -q --vcs-ref HEAD --defaults --data project_name=demo --data codeowners=@o --data "harnesses=[opencode]" /home/vscode/kmctl-starter $d/demo; python3 -c "import yaml,sys; a=yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert a[\"targets\"]==[\"opencode\"], a; assert a[\"dependencies\"][\"apm\"][0][\"ref\"]==\"v0.5.1\", a" $d/demo/apm.yml; grep -q "kmctl_ref := \"v0.5.1\"" $d/demo/justfile; grep -q "v0.5.1" $d/demo/.github/workflows/ci.yml; rm -rf $d'

signed_rows.behavior: copier refuses harnesses including opencode with kmctl_ref v0.5.0, naming v0.5.1, and still accepts [claude] with v0.5.0.
signed_rows.fails_when: copier renders opencode at v0.5.0, its refusal does not name v0.5.1, or it refuses [claude] at v0.5.0
signed_rows.command: bash -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); out=$(uvx copier copy -q --vcs-ref HEAD --defaults --data project_name=demo --data codeowners=@o --data "harnesses=[opencode]" --data kmctl_ref=v0.5.0 /home/vscode/kmctl-starter $d/a 2>&1) && exit 1; echo "$out" | grep -q v0.5.1 || exit 1; uvx copier copy -q --vcs-ref HEAD --defaults --data project_name=demo --data codeowners=@o --data "harnesses=[claude]" --data kmctl_ref=v0.5.0 /home/vscode/kmctl-starter $d/b; rc=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $rc'

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl-starter's test workflow on GitHub, for the pushed commit, passes for every matrix entry, including [opencode] and [claude, antigravity, opencode]: render, YAML parse and the pre-commit hooks of the generated project. Its bootstrap steps are off while JasperHG90/kmctl is private, with a comment saying so, and the same bootstrap passes locally for both OpenCode entries with doctor failing only on dep.claude, dep.agy, dep.opencode and antigravity.trust.
signed_rows.fails_when: any matrix entry fails, the opencode entries are missing, the bootstrap steps are off without saying why, or the local bootstrap of an OpenCode entry fails or doctor fails another check

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl-starter's README.md and template/README.md.jinja tell an OpenCode user what they need: OpenCode 2.x only, start a new session after just bootstrap, every rule loads in every session, run just install again after any apm install; the README's harnesses row names OpenCode.
signed_rows.fails_when: any of those is missing or contradicts kmctl's docs

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl-starter has a v0.3.0 tag (plain, as v0.1.0 to v0.2.1) and a GitHub release on the commit that holds this change, pushed after kmctl v0.5.1 became Latest, and uvx copier copy --defaults gh:JasperHG90/kmctl-starter with harnesses [opencode] renders from it.
signed_rows.fails_when: the tag or release is missing, sits on another commit, or copier from GitHub refuses or does not offer opencode

resigns.reason: Operator, 2026-10-18: skip the starter's CI bootstrap while kmctl is private (every run since 946e051 failed on fetching it); r4 now asks CI to render and lint every entry and the bootstrap to pass locally
